mapper.select: SELECT id, parent_id, menu_name, menu_type, perms, path, component, icon, sort FROM sys_menu WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_menu (parent_id, menu_name, menu_type, perms, path, component, icon, sort) VALUES (#{parentId}, #{menuName}, #{menuType}, #{perms}, #{path}, #{component}, #{icon}, #{sort})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_menu SET parent_id = #{parentId}, menu_name = #{menuName}, menu_type = #{menuType}, perms = #{perms}, path = #{path}, component = #{component}, icon = #{icon}, sort = #{sort} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_menu SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
